result.topic_en: Applying the boundary conditions at the free end of the vibrating elastic lamina yields sin ζ = 0, so ζ = iπ, giving the vibration times and frequencies of successive modes, which rise as the square numbers.
result.transcription:
478 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
faciendo $\Phi = \zeta$ nihilo aequale eſſe debet, ex quo fiet
$-A\cos.\zeta - B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta} = 0.$
Denique quum hoc loco etiam ſit $y = 0$, habebimus inſuper
$A\cos.\zeta + B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta} = 0$
quae duae poſtremae aequationes cum binis illis initio inuentis problema noſtrum penitus reſoluent. Quare quum ſupra inueniſſemus $A = 0$ et $D = -C$, hae duae poſteriores aequationes dabunt
$-B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} - Ce^{-\zeta} = 0$ et $B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} - Ce^{-\zeta} = 0$
vnde manifeſto ſequitur, fore $B\sin.\zeta = 0$, ſiue $\sin.\zeta = 0$, ideoque $\zeta$ vel $\pi$ vel $2\pi$ vel $3\pi$ vel $4\pi$ etc. ſiue in genere $\zeta = i\pi = \frac{\theta a}{b}$ ita vt habeamus $\theta = \frac{ib\pi}{a}$, quare quum pro tempore vnius vibrationis ſit $\theta\theta t = \pi$ erit hoc tempus $= \frac{aa}{iibb.\pi}$, vnde diuerſas vibrationum ſpecies ſequenti Tabella exhibemus:

| Tempus vnius vibrat. | Sonus ſeu num. vibrat.
$i = 1$ | $0,3183\frac{aa}{bb}$ | $3,1416\frac{bb}{aa}$
$i = 2$ | $0,0796$ | $12,5664\frac{bb}{aa}$
$i = 3$ | $0,0354$ | $28,2744\frac{bb}{aa}$
$i = 4$ | $0,0199$ | $50,2656\frac{bb}{aa}$
etc. | etc.

ſicque hi diuerſi ſoni ſecundum ipſos numeros quadratos intenduntur.

Coroll.

items.quote: quae duae poſtremae aequationes cum binis illis initio inuentis problema noſtrum penitus reſoluent.
items.english: These last two equations, together with the two found at the beginning, will completely solve our problem.

items.quote: ſicque hi diuerſi ſoni ſecundum ipſos numeros quadratos intenduntur.
items.english: And thus these different sounds rise in pitch according to the square numbers themselves.
